issues.issue: Is the claimant credible and does he have a well-founded fear of persecution based on family membership and ethnic group?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant fears persecution due to family and Malinke ethnic group membership.
issues.respondent_position: Claimant is not credible; inconsistencies and lack of corroboration undermine claim.
issues.result_text: Claimant did not meet burden to establish well-founded fear of persecution.

issues.issue: Does the claimant qualify for protection under section 97 IRPA for risk to life or cruel and unusual treatment?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant argues risk of torture under Article 1 of the Convention Against Torture.
issues.respondent_position: Claimant is not credible and not wanted by authorities; claim for risk to life and cruel treatment fails.
issues.result_text: Claim for risk to life and cruel treatment fails due to lack of credibility.
